mount-flat-500-none.basis: One mount per session; matches the Node table's mount rows (weight 1).

mount-flat-500-validate.basis: One mount per session; matches the Node table's mount rows (weight 1).

mount-if-flat-500-none.basis: One mount per session; matches the Node table's mount rows (weight 1).

mount-if-flat-500-validate.basis: One mount per session; matches the Node table's mount rows (weight 1).

mount-nested-d5-f4-validate.basis: One mount per session; matches the Node table's mount-nested row (weight 1).

mount-array-1000-validate.basis: One mount per session; matches the Node table's mount rows (weight 1).

type-flat-500-validate-nonburst.basis: The browser path goes through the FieldProxy subscription, so it matches the Node 'typing with subscribers' row (weight 5000).

type-array-1000-validate-nonburst.basis: No Node counterpart; harness assumption that typing inside an array is one fifth as frequent as flat typing.

first-key-flat-500-validate.basis: One first key per session: the owner rule's one-off first-write term, kept as its own row.

first-key-flat-500-validate-after-load.basis: One first key after load validation settles; kept alongside the immediate first key at the same weight to distinguish load overlap from settled-load input cost.

rebuild-flat-500.excluded: 0.16.1 has no rebuild, so the row is excluded from this comparison.
